faqs.question: How does admission to RKDF University work?
faqs.answer: RKDF’s 2026–27 policy describes university registration, verification and counselling. Its agriculture row identifies PAT, CUET or qualifying-examination merit. Register through the university route: The policy allows online registration and assistance at the campus counselling centre. Complete original-document checking: Selected applicants report with applicable originals and copies under the published policy.

faqs.question: What are the entry requirements for B.Sc. (Hons.) Agriculture at RKDF University?
faqs.answer: 2026–27: 10+2 PCM/PCB or agriculture subjects, with 50% for General/OBC non-creamy-layer and 45% for SC/ST.

faqs.question: Which application documents does RKDF University list?
faqs.answer: Class 10 and Class 12 marksheets; Aadhaar card; Transfer/leaving, character and migration certificates; Applicable category, domicile and income certificates. Check the applicable notice for originals, formats and category-specific certificates.

faqs.question: What are the entry requirements for B.Sc. (Hons.) Agriculture at RKDF University?
faqs.answer: 2026–27: 10+2 PCM/PCB or agriculture subjects, with 50% for General/OBC non-creamy-layer and 45% for SC/ST.

faqs.question: How does admission to RKDF University work?
faqs.answer: RKDF’s 2026–27 policy describes university registration, verification and counselling. Its agriculture row identifies PAT, CUET or qualifying-examination merit. Register through the university route: The policy allows online registration and assistance at the campus counselling centre. Complete original-document checking: Selected applicants report with applicable originals and copies under the published policy.
